name: Yu-Gi-Oh! The Duelists of the Roses
subtitle: Yu-Gi-Oh!  ·  PAL
notice: Duelists of the Roses is in beta. You will encounter bugs and missing pieces.

texts.import_needed: Not imported yet. You need your own PAL ISO of the game (SLES-51579).
texts.saves: Nothing is saved automatically: on the campaign map choose SYSTEM → SAVE; Continue on the title screen loads it.
texts.controls: Xbox, DualSense and DualShock 4 pads work directly (USB or Bluetooth), buttons in the PS2 layout by position. Keyboard: arrows = D-pad · X Cross · Z Circle · A Square · D Triangle · S Start · Tab Select · Q/E = L1/R1 · 1/W = L2/R2.
texts.running: The game is running. Save on the campaign map with SYSTEM → SAVE.
texts.ready: Save on the campaign map with SYSTEM → SAVE; Continue on the title screen loads it.
